verdict_rules.pass: reachable, non-blank, >=80% controls present, action controls that respond in UWP golden also respond in WinUI
verdict_rules.partial: reachable, >=40% control coverage, or controls present but action dead vs UWP

notes: UWP golden 'Apply preferences' button produced no visible text change (newTokens=0) because with no checkbox selected the auto-rotation preference stays 'None'; behavioral responsiveness is therefore not a differentiator here. The dominant signal is structural: whether the scenario page and its controls render at all.
